plain:
歌名：恩典
专辑：长爱歌
音乐人：圣天飞歌

有一种结果 你换不来
有一种亏缺 挽回不了
有一种恩典 在万古之先
这一种恩典 可靠而圣洁 
There’s an ending that cannot be changed
There’s a debt that cannot be repaid
There’s a grace come from the beginning of the world
This grace is holy and unchanging

世上一切都需要交换
努力的可以得到工价
而我却不知道  我最需要的 不是能赚取的
We need to pay a price for everything
The hardworking will earn his wages
Yet I never knew
The one thing I need most
Cannot be earned

因我所欠的 无法偿还
不配得到的 却白白得到 
在恩典中    主替我偿还 
我不敢相信 这恩典简单到只需要相信   
I can never repay what I owned
Undeserving yet freely given
My Lord through grace has paid the ransom for me
I dare not believe this grace is as simple as just believing in it

主啊  你会赦免我多少次
当我一次次软弱跌倒 
当我在过犯中 单单得罪你  
O Lord how many times will You forgive me
When time after time I fall
When I am in my transgression
To You only have I sinned 

你的心最痛
为我担忧 为我叹息
我跪在你面前悔改哭泣    
你瞬间挪走那沉重的压力 
It’s Your heart that hurts most
You worry and sigh for me
I kneel before You weeping in repentance
You remove all my heavy burden in an instant 

今天不要求明天的恩典 
那样明天你会远离他
他每日的恩典   够你用
不会显多 不会缺少 
用恩典遮盖我
赤身露体
保守我不从恩典中坠落
Don’t seek tomorrow’s grace today
Or you would like to go far away from Him tomorrow
His grace is sufficient for you each new day
Just enough for whatever need
Cover me with Your grace over all my being
Don’t let me fall away from Your grace

软弱中认识你的恩典 
父在爱子里赐的恩典
我不配得到的  我最需要的 就是这份恩典 
When I am weak it’s there I find Your grace
Father’s grace given through His beloved Son
Undeserving yet I receive
The one thing I need most is this grace 


点击听歌☞ https://zanms.net/s21899
